The app shell provides the top navigation and footer. Set the active nav item to 'Courses'.

Page structure & content:
1. Breadcrumb & Page Header:
   - Breadcrumb: Home / Courses (Home link, Courses active)
   - Title: 'All Courses' with subtle total badge (48 Courses Available)
   - Subtitle: 'Master corporate-grade analytics, financial modeling, SQL pipelines, and BI reporting with industry-vetted masterclasses.'
   - Quick Category Pill filters directly under the title: All, Advanced Excel, Power Query, SQL & Databases, Python & Automation, BI Dashboards.

2. Catalog Layout with 2-Column Split:
   - Left Sidebar (w-72 or w-80, sticky/scrollable filter panel inside a clean white card with subtle border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm):
     - Filter Header with 'Filters' title and 'Clear all filters' link in indigo-600.
     - Search / Keyword filter small input or quick search.
     - Category (checkboxes with count badges): Advanced Excel (14), Power Query & ETL (8), SQL & Databases (12), Python for Data (9), BI & Executive Dashboards (5).
     - Experience Level (checkboxes with badge styling): Beginner (green-100 text-green-700), Intermediate (amber-100 text-amber-700), Advanced (red-100 text-red-700).
     - Rating (radio buttons or checkboxes): 4.5 & up ★★★★½ (32), 4.0 & up ★★★★☆ (44), 3.5 & up (48).
     - Duration: Under 5 hours (6), 5-15 hours (18), 15-30 hours (16), 30+ hours (8).
     - Price: All, Free (3), Paid ($0 - $100) (24), Premium ($100 - $250) (21).
     - Software & Tools: Microsoft Excel, Power BI, PostgreSQL, Pandas, Tableau.

   - Main Content Area (flex-1):
     - Toolbar bar above the grid:
       - Search input with search icon: 'Search courses, skills, tools...'
       - Result text: 'Showing 12 of 48 courses'
       - Sort dropdown: 'Sort by: Popularity' (options: Most Popular, Highest Rated, Newest, Price: Low to High, Price: High to Low)
       - View toggle (Grid / List view icons, grid active)
     - Grid of Course Cards (3 columns x 3 rows = 9 rich course cards):
       1. Advanced Excel Financial Modeling & Dynamic Arrays (Category: Excel | Level: Advanced | Rating: 4.9 (3,420) | Enrolled: 12.4k | 18.5 hrs | 42 lessons | Instructor: Sarah Jenkins, Ex-McKinsey Lead | Price: $89 reg $149 -40%)
       2. Power Query & Automated ETL Architectures (Category: Power Query | Level: Intermediate | Rating: 4.8 (1,890) | Enrolled: 8.2k | 14 hrs | 30 lessons | Instructor: Marcus Chen, Principal BI Architect | Price: $79 reg $129 -38%)
       3. SQL for Modern Data Analysis & Warehousing (Category: SQL | Level: All Levels / Intermediate | Rating: 4.9 (4,150) | Enrolled: 15.1k | 22 hrs | 56 lessons | Instructor: Elena Rostova, Senior Data Engineer | Price: $99 reg $169 -41%)
       4. Python for Business Dashboards & Analytics (Category: Python | Level: Intermediate | Rating: 4.8 (2,680) | Enrolled: 9.8k | 26 hrs | 64 lessons | Instructor: David Kalu, Head of Data Science | Price: $119 reg $199 -40%)
       5. Executive BI Dashboards with Power BI & DAX (Category: Dashboards | Level: Advanced | Rating: 4.9 (2,100) | Enrolled: 7.4k | 16 hrs | 38 lessons | Instructor: Rachel Vance, Director of Enterprise BI | Price: $94 reg $150 -37%)
       6. Automated Financial Reporting with VBA & Python (Category: Excel & Python | Level: Advanced | Rating: 4.7 (1,240) | Enrolled: 5.6k | 20 hrs | 48 lessons | Instructor: Michael Torres, Quantitative Risk Analyst | Price: $84 reg $140 -40%)
       7. PostgreSQL & Data Modeling for Analytics Engineers (Category: SQL | Level: Beginner to Intermediate | Rating: 4.8 (1,730) | Enrolled: 6.9k | 18 hrs | 40 lessons | Instructor: Alex Mercer, Lead Data Platform Architect | Price: $89 reg $139 -36%)
       8. Complete Data Storytelling & C-Suite Presentations (Category: Dashboards | Level: All Levels | Rating: 4.9 (3,890) | Enrolled: 11.2k | 12 hrs | 28 lessons | Instructor: Sophia Martinez, Strategy Director | Price: $69 reg $110 -37%)
       9. Applied Machine Learning for Financial Analysts (Category: Python | Level: Advanced | Rating: 4.8 (980) | Enrolled: 4.1k | 28 hrs | 60 lessons | Instructor: Dr. Julian Vance, Quant Researcher | Price: $129 reg $219 -41%)
       
       Card details:
       - Crisp high-tech / analytics mockups or realistic screenshots for card thumbnails with top overlay category tag and bookmark button.
       - Title in bold Inter text-slate-900 line-clamp-1 hover:text-indigo-600 transition.
       - 2-line description in text-slate-600 text-sm.
       - Metadata row: Star rating in amber-400 with score and count, student enrolled badge.
       - Duration & lesson count row with clock and book/video icons.
       - Instructor avatar image + name and title.
       - Bottom footer row: current price in bold text-lg text-slate-900, struck-through original price, green or indigo discount percent badge, and a quick 'Enroll' or arrow button.

     - Bottom hint card:
       - A subtle empty-state hint / filtered notification card: 'Looking for a specialized enterprise track? No more courses match current filters' with 'Reset Filters' button and 'Request Custom Cohort' link.
     - Pagination component:
       - Centered pagination bar: 'Previous', page numbers [1] (active indigo), [2], [3], '...', [6], 'Next', and page jump status.
